question: Which Indian sportsperson won the 'World Games Athlete of the Year' award in January 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rani Rampal.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian women's team captain Rani Rampal became the first-ever hockey player to win the prestigious World Games Athlete of the Year award.
 
• In 2019, India won the FIH Series Finals, and Rani was named Player of the Tournament.
 
• Rani was also recently named among the Padma Shri awardees.
 
• The World Games announced the winner on 30 Jan 2020.
 
• She has won with 1,99,477 votes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Veteran Indian Hockey goalkeeper **P R Sreejesh **has won the prestigious** World Games Athlete of the Year for his 2021 **performances.
 
• Sreejesh beat competition from sports climber Alberto Gins Lopez of Spain and Italy’s wushu player Michele Giordano for the award.
